questions.question: Name the type of angle formed by the clock hands at 2, 3, 5 and 6 o'clock, and give each size.
questions.expected_answer: 2 o'clock 60° acute; 3 o'clock 90° right; 5 o'clock 150° obtuse; 6 o'clock 180° straight.

questions.question: Describe how to measure an angle with a protractor and how to avoid reading the wrong scale.
questions.expected_answer: Place the centre on the vertex, line the baseline along one arm at 0, and read the scale that starts at 0 on that arm. Estimate the type first: an acute angle must read less than 90°.

questions.question: Explain two ways to measure a reflex angle whose inside angle is 60°.
questions.expected_answer: Subtract the inside angle from 360°: 360° − 60° = 300°. Or extend an arm to a straight line and add: 180° + 120° = 300°.
